title: Event Card
content: Build event card for social events. Cover: event image with date overlay badge. Details: title, host, date/time, location with map link. RSVP: Going/Interested/Not Going buttons. Attendees: avatar stack of going users, count. Sharing: share event button. Reminders: add to calendar. Recurring: series indicator.

variants.simple: Create social event card with date, location, and RSVP.
variants.detailed: Build event card for social events. Cover: event image with date overlay badge. Details: title, host, date/time, location with map link. RSVP: Going/Interested/Not Going buttons. Attendees: avatar stack of going users, count. Sharing: share event button. Reminders: add to calendar. Recurring: series indicator.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive social event card with RSVP and details. Card container: bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden. Cover image: aspect-video object-cover relative. Date badge: absolute top-4 left-4 bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-2 text-center, month (text-xs uppercase text-red-500 font-medium "JAN"), day (text-2xl font-bold "15"). Status badge: absolute top-4 right-4, "Happening Now" (bg-red-500 animate-pulse), "Tomorrow", "This Weekend". Event details: p-4. Title: text-xl font-bold line-clamp-2. Host: flex items-center gap-2 mt-2, avatar (w-6 h-6), "Hosted by [Name]" or "By [Organization]". Date/time: Calendar icon + "Saturday, January 15, 2024" + "7:00 PM - 10:00 PM", relative ("in 3 days"). Location: MapPin icon + venue name + address line, "Online Event" with Video icon for virtual. Map preview: small map thumbnail with pin, tap opens directions. RSVP section: flex gap-2 mt-4. Going: primary button, Interested: secondary/outline, Ignore: text button or implicit. Selected state: button filled with check icon. RSVP counts: "124 going · 56 interested" text. Attendee preview: avatar stack of friends going ("Sarah, John and 3 friends going"), then "124 total going". Ticket info: if paid event, price display ("$25"), "Get Tickets" button linking to purchase. Add to calendar: Calendar+ icon button, generates .ics file or opens calendar app. Share: Share icon opens share sheet. Event details expandable: description text (line-clamp-3 with "See more"), full details include agenda, what to bring, host notes. Recurring indicator: "Repeating event - Every Monday" badge. RSVP deadline: "RSVP by Jan 10" warning. Capacity: "Limited spots - 20 remaining" urgency. Private event: Lock icon, invite-only. Reminder: "Remind me" toggle sets notification. Cancel/update notice: if event changed, highlighted banner. Discussion: link to event discussion/comments. Mobile: full-width cards, easy tap targets. Accessibility: date and time clearly formatted, RSVP status announced, interactive elements labeled.
